title: Police department helicopter
summary: On January 17, 2025, the council passed Bill 4 (2025) on first reading, adding $450,000 for police helicopter operations. The bill concerns the police asset forfeiture program budget. Earlier, on October 25, 2024, the council voted 9 to 0 to move $350,000 in the police budget for a helicopter hoist.
